propositions: Plan review criterion must classify every acceptance-criterion item as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested based on where completion evidence can be truthfully verified.
Externally verifiable criteria must be tagged with exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] token; untagged external criteria or malformed tags should produce findings requiring the exact syntax.
Codebase-verifiable criteria carrying [operator-attested] tag should produce findings explaining ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof; untagged codebase criteria are accepted.
Criteria bundles mixing repository proof and outside-world proof must not be silently assigned one evidence kind; review must require splitting into independently certifiable criteria.
High-confidence evidence-classification mismatches must participate in blocking validity policy while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open.
